title: Tiny, cute bicycle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='64' r='17' fill='none' stroke='#FF6FB5' stroke-width='5'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='64' r='17' fill='none' stroke='#FF6FB5' stroke-width='5'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='64' r='4' fill='#6FE3FF'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='64' r='4' fill='#6FE3FF'/>
  <!-- spokes -->
  <g stroke='#FFD36F' stroke-width='2'>
    <line x1='26' y1='48' x2='26' y2='80'/>
    <line x1='10' y1='64' x2='42' y2='64'/>
    <line x1='74' y1='48' x2='74' y2='80'/>
    <line x1='58' y1='64' x2='90' y2='64'/>
  </g>
  <!-- frame -->
  <g stroke='#7CFF9B' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'>
    <line x1='26' y1='64' x2='46' y2='40'/>
    <line x1='46' y1='40' x2='66' y2='40'/>
    <line x1='66' y1='40' x2='74' y2='64'/>
    <line x1='46' y1='40' x2='50' y2='64'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='64' x2='74' y2='64'/>
  </g>
  <!-- seat -->
  <rect x='40' y='33' width='14' height='6' rx='3' fill='#FF9B54'/>
  <!-- handlebar -->
  <line x1='66' y1='40' x2='72' y2='30' stroke='#9BA8FF' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='66' y1='30' x2='78' y2='30' stroke='#9BA8FF' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- pedals -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='64' r='4' fill='#FF6FB5'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='64' x2='50' y2='74' stroke='#7CFF9B' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <rect x='44' y='73' width='12' height='4' rx='2' fill='#FFD36F'/>
</svg>
